  muster server reload-config      Reload config.toml in the running server

  muster machine <subcommand>      Manage saved SSH machines
  muster api <subcommand>          Inspect socket API metadata and live runtime state
  muster workspace <subcommand>    Workspace helpers over the socket API
  muster worktree <subcommand>     Git worktree helpers over the socket API
  muster tab <subcommand>          Tab helpers over the socket API
  muster notification <subcommand> Notification helpers over the socket API
  muster agent <subcommand>        Agent/terminal helpers over the socket API
  muster pane <subcommand>         Pane control helpers over the socket API
  muster session <subcommand>      Manage named persistent sessions
  muster integration <subcommand>  Manage built-in agent integrations

Advanced commands:
  muster server                    Run as headless server

Options:
  --session <name>    Use or create a named persistent session
  --machine <label-or-id>  Run an API command on a saved SSH machine
  --remote <target>   Attach through SSH to a remote Muster server
  --remote-keybindings <local|server>
                      Keybindings for --remote app attach (default: local)
  --handoff           Opt into live handoff for update or remote attach
  --default-config    Print default configuration and exit
  --skill             Print the agent skill file and exit

  --help, -h          Show this help
